repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard specifically designed for AI coding agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based local dashboard that integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and OpenRouter.
Purpose: Provides granular visibility into agentic workflows by tracking work steps, file modifications, and test execution.
Use Cases: Financial auditing of AI development costs, debugging agent performance, and monitoring token consumption per task.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: YizhiSong/FriesTrader
repos.description: A fully automated AI trading agent that trades real Robinhood orders via its Agentic Trading MCP under mechanical, auditable risk rules the model cannot override. Once set up, it is able to run on its own schedule, screening and trading stocks under a narrow, explicit gate. Cheap to run — Claude Pro only, no metered API spend. Not financial advice.
repos.one_liner: A fully automated AI trading agent that executes Robinhood orders under strict, model-agnostic risk constraints.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based agentic framework utilizing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for secure execution.
Purpose: Bridges the gap between LLM-driven decision-making and auditable, hard-coded financial risk management.
Use Cases: Automated retail trading with safety guardrails that prevent the AI from overriding risk parameters.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first, high-performance visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series analysis.
bullets: Tech Stack: Rust-based, ROS 2 native architecture; a high-performance fork of the Rerun visualization toolkit.
Purpose: Designed to handle complex, high-frequency time-series data streams common in robotics and quantitative sensor analysis.
Use Cases: Visualizing real-time telemetry, debugging complex data pipelines, and analyzing multimodal sensor logs.
